## Research focus

The lab's working programme centres on how cities generate, transfer and use evidence for climate action, connecting questions of policy learning, governance, valuation, workforce change, evidence infrastructure and comparative urban policy.

## Approach

The intended approach combines academic research with careful attention to the real institutions, tools and professional communities through which local climate action is delivered. Final biographical wording and research history will be added after owner review.
